
### Download

| Device | File |
|---|---|
| Android 8+ | `Kitchtally-…-Android.apk` |
| iPhone and iPad (iOS 16+) | `Kitchtally-…-iOS.ipa`, installed with AltStore or Sideloadly |

Kitchtally isn't in any app store yet, so your device may warn you the first time. See the [install guide](https://github.com/rachitratnammudaliar/kitchtally#install) for each device.
